# Anaxagoras of Clazomenae

*500 BCE – 428 BCE · Greek*

Coming from Clazomenae to Athens, he holds that everything is in everything and that an Intellect (*nous*) set the original mixture in order. Charged with impiety for saying the sun is a red-hot stone, he had to leave the city.
